label: Default — mid-campaign certainty

recentEvents.value: Liberated another realm from its Dread Sovereign — his framing; the survivors' grief he reads as survivor's guilt, a tragic consequence of witnessing true evil.
The hub's concerned faces only confirm how much they need him to remain strong for all of them.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Everyone he trusts begs him to stop; he hears fear, corruption, or admiration for his sacrifice — never the words themselves.

temporaryObjective.value: Reach the next Dread Sovereign before the ten can finish gathering their strength.

notes: He hears every plea verbatim (fact_amulet_translation_is_accurate is in his knows bucket) and reinterprets all of it. activeQuestStages is empty because his arc spans all ten rungs. factsLearned is deliberately empty: learning is the one thing he does not do.
